facts.fact: Echos Sante reports that the Pandemic Fund's FCFA 13.44bn grant, within a FCFA 91.5bn (about US$160m) 2026-2029 project, has as a stated deliverable increased interoperability of Cameroon's national health information systems, with project activities launched on 2026-07-29.
facts.system: Pandemic Fund Cameroon pandemic prevention, preparedness and response project (national health information systems interoperability)
